title: A Founder pays no finder's fee on any sale through Jan 31, 2028

source.ref: Launch milestones doc rulings 2026-11-23 (project thread: Build the Founding Year checkout; owner picked 'Start a thread now' 2026-11-25 00:09Z)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-25: the Founder fee perk is stale. Founding Businesses keep a locked 3% buy-down, and nothing waives the 10% finder's fee (capped $20, ADR-1978) for a Founding Year buyer. Owner ruling 2026-11-23: no finder's fee on anyone through January 31, 2028, replacing the old 3% promise. Fix: one pure rule in founding-year.ts that fees.ts asks, so every Space sale path (tickets, memberships, shop) charges 0 to a Founder until Feb 1, 2028.

DONE 2026-11-25: FOUNDING_YEAR.noFindersFeeUntil = 2028-02-01T08:00Z and founderPaysNoFindersFee (pure) in lib/billing/founding-year.ts. lib/billing/fees.ts foundingLockedTakeBps answers 0 for an ACTIVE founder row carrying meta.founding_year (getFoundingStatus now exposes foundingYear), so spaceNetworkBps and spaceTakeRateCents charge nothing on every Space sale path (tickets, memberships, shop) and the receipt records the same 0. A lapsed Founder pays the ordinary fee; from Feb 1, 2028 the fee returns. The Founding Year note says so. Tests: lib/billing/fees-collective.test.ts.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
